Slots #3, #4, #2, #5, #1, #6, #7 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #4 ranks 2 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.41 expected PA/game vs 4.31 at primary slot #4. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
